performance.scenario: Three nested scroll notifications before next frame

performance.scope: Synthetic event/measurement counters, not physical device latency

limitations: Browser verification used installed Windows Chrome headless; Firefox, Safari, mobile hardware and assistive technology are not verified.
Software keyboard viewport geometry was reproduced with a mocked VisualViewport in a component test; a physical on-screen keyboard is not verified.
Theme matrix verifies geometry and resolved text color, not a complete contrast-ratio audit of every gradient and animation frame.
Not every layout component has every size/theme Cartesian combination executed; source-only coverage is explicitly marked in the matrix.
Source harness is separate from the packed-consumer check owned by the parent agent; it does not substitute for package verification.
